If the campaign is not active it returns\n// ok=false. The caller must already have verified the caller is the owner.\nfunc dbNudge(campaignID string) (string, int, bool, error) {\n\ttx, err := db.Begin()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, err\n\t}\n\tdefer tx.Rollback()\n\n\tvar status string\n\tvar actor sql.NullString\n\tvar nudgeCount int\n\terr = tx.QueryRow(\n\t\t\"SELECT status, current_actor, nudge_count FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\",\n\t\tcampaignID,\n\t).Scan(&status, &actor, &nudgeCount)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, err\n\t}\n\tif status != \"active\" {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, nil\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\"UPDATE play_campaigns SET nudge_count = nudge_count + 1 WHERE id = ?\",\n\t\tcampaignID,\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn \"\", 0, false, err\n\t}\n\treturn actor.String, nudgeCount + 1, true, nil\n}\n\n// dbCreateAction appends a player action event to a play campaign, advances the\n// turn pointer to the DM, and returns the public action response. If the\n// campaign is not active or the caller is not the current actor, it returns\n// ok=false and no error.\nfunc dbCreateAction(campaignID, username string, req *actionRequest) (*actionResponse, bool, error) {\n\ttx, err := db.Begin()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\tdefer tx.Rollback()\n\n\tvar status, owner string\n\tvar actor sql.NullString\n\terr = tx.QueryRow(\n\t\t\"SELECT status, owner, current_actor FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\",\n\t\tcampaignID,\n\t).Scan(&status, &owner, &actor)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, false, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\tif status != \"active\" || actor.String != username {\n\t\treturn nil, false, nil\n\t}\n\n\tvar nextSeq int\n\terr = tx.QueryRow(\n\t\t\"SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) + 1 FROM play_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?\",\n\t\tcampaignID,\n\t).Scan(&nextSeq)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\"INSERT INTO play_narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, type, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n\t\tcampaignID, nextSeq, \"action\", username, req.Type, req.Text,\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\"UPDATE play_campaigns SET current_actor = ?, turn_number = turn_number + 1 WHERE id = ?\",\n\t\towner, campaignID,\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\n\treturn &actionResponse{\n\t\tSequence:  nextSeq,\n\t\tKind:      \"action\",\n\t\tActor:     username,\n\t\tType:      req.Type,\n\t\tText:      req.Text,\n\t\tNextActor: \"dm\",\n\t}, true, nil\n}\n\n// dbCreateResolution appends a GM resolution event to a play campaign, advances\n// the turn pointer to the next player, and returns the public resolution\n// response. If the campaign is not active or the caller is not the current\n// owner actor, it returns ok=false and no error.\nfunc dbCreateResolution(campaignID, username, text string) (*resolutionResponse, bool, error) {\n\ttx, err := db.Begin()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\tdefer tx.Rollback()\n\n\tvar status, owner string\n\tvar actor sql.NullString\n\tvar turnNumber int\n\terr = tx.QueryRow(\n\t\t\"SELECT status, owner, current_actor, turn_number FROM play_campaigns WHERE id = ?\",\n\t\tcampaignID,\n\t).Scan(&status, &owner, &actor, &turnNumber)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, false, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, false, err\n\t}\n\tif status != \"active\" || actor.String != username || username != owner {\n\t\treturn nil, false, nil\n\t}\n\n\trows, err := tx.Query(\n\t\t\"SELECT username FROM play_members WHERE campaign_id = ?
